comment: SimpleTab's curated extension list (design section 11, item 6). Reviewed like code; each entry is checked in the built app before release (docs/checks/M9.md).

extensions.name: Rainbow CSV
extensions.purpose: Colours and aligns CSV columns, and checks each row's column count.

extensions.name: Edit CSV
extensions.purpose: Edits a CSV file as a table.

extensions.name: Excel Viewer
extensions.purpose: Shows .xlsx and CSV files as a grid.

extensions.name: Markdown language
extensions.purpose: Recognises Markdown files, with highlighting, so notes and briefings read well and can be spell-checked.

extensions.name: Code Spell Checker
extensions.purpose: Spell-checks motions, info slides and notes in English.
